travel
旅行
Would you rather travel slowly through one region or visit several countries?
I prefer to travel slowly through one region. Staying longer lets me explore ordinary streets instead of spending every day in transit.
我比較喜歡在同一個地區慢慢旅行。多住幾天，才能逛逛日常街道，不必每天趕車。
journey
旅程
What would make a long train journey enjoyable for you?
A window seat would make the journey more enjoyable. I would bring a book but leave time to watch the scenery.
坐窗邊會讓長途旅程更愉快。我會帶本書，也留點時間看看沿途風景。
trip
旅行
How would you plan a trip with friends who have different budgets?
We would agree on a spending limit before booking the trip. Optional activities would let people choose what suits them.
安排旅行前，我們會先談好預算上限。有些活動自由參加，大家就能照自己的情況選擇。
passport
護照
What precautions would you take with your passport while travelling?
I would keep my passport in a secure place. I would also store a separate copy in case I needed its details.
我會把護照放在安全的地方。另外分開存一份影本，臨時需要資料時比較方便。
ticket
車票
Do you usually buy your train ticket early or at the station, and why?
I usually buy my train ticket online a few days early, especially before long weekends. If I wait until the last minute, all the seats may be sold out.
我通常會提前幾天上網買車票，尤其是連假前。如果拖到最後一刻，座位可能都賣光了。
station
車站
You are meeting someone at a busy station. How would you choose a meeting point?
I would choose a numbered exit outside the station. It would be easier to find than an unspecified spot near the platforms.
我會約在車站外有編號的出口。比起只說月台附近，這樣比較不容易找錯。
airport
機場
How would you use extra time at an airport?
At the airport, I would find my gate before getting food. Knowing where to return would help me relax while waiting.
到機場後，我會先找到登機門，再去買吃的。知道等一下要回哪裡，等待時也比較安心。
flight
班機
Your flight is cancelled. What would you check first?
I would ask the airline about the next available flight. Before booking elsewhere, I would check what assistance my ticket includes.
我會先問航空公司下一班可搭的班機。改買別家的票前，也會確認原票能獲得哪些協助。
luggage
行李
How do you decide what belongs in your hand luggage?
My hand luggage would contain medicine, documents, and a change of clothes. Those would matter most if my checked bag arrived late.
隨身行李會放藥、證件和一套換洗衣物。托運行李晚到時，這些東西最重要。
hotel
旅館
What information would you ask a hotel for before a late arrival?
I would ask the hotel whether someone would be at reception. I would also request clear instructions for checking in after midnight.
我會先問旅館櫃台晚上有沒有人。也請他們說明，過了午夜要怎麼辦理入住。
reservation
預訂
You arrive at a restaurant, but it cannot find your reservation. What would you do?
I would show the reservation confirmation on my phone. If there were a mistake, I would ask about the next available table.
我會出示手機上的預訂確認。若真的出了差錯，就問最快什麼時候有位子。
map
地圖
When would you prefer a paper map to a phone?
I would carry a paper map on a remote hike. It would still be useful if my phone ran out of power.
到偏遠地方健行時，我會帶紙本地圖。手機沒電了，也還能確認路線。
route
路線
Would you choose the fastest route or a more scenic one?
I would choose the scenic route if I had enough daylight. When arriving on time matters, I would take the faster option.
白天時間充裕的話，我會走風景好的路線。如果一定要準時到，就選比較快的。
direction
方向
What would you do if you were unsure which direction to walk?
I would stop somewhere safe and check the direction on my map. Walking while guessing could take me farther away.
我會先停在安全的地方，查地圖確認方向。一邊猜一邊走，可能反而越走越遠。
arrive
抵達
How early would you aim to arrive for an important appointment in a new city?
I would aim to arrive twenty minutes early. That would leave time to find the entrance without making anyone wait too long.
我會抓提早二十分鐘抵達。這樣有時間找入口，也不會讓對方等得太久。
depart
出發
What would you check before you depart on a family trip?
Before we depart, I would check the weather and make sure I have my phone charger. I would also ask my parents what time we plan to arrive.
出發前，我會先看天氣，也確認手機充電器有帶。我還會問爸媽預計幾點抵達。
delay
延誤
How would you tell a host about a travel delay?
I would explain the delay as soon as I knew about it. A realistic arrival estimate would be more useful than a vague apology.
知道行程延誤後，我會立刻告訴接待的人。比起一直道歉，提供實際的抵達時間更有幫助。
miss
錯過
You might miss the last bus. What would you do?
I would check alternatives before I actually miss the bus. If necessary, I would arrange a safe place to stay nearby.
確定會錯過末班車之前，我會先查替代交通。必要時，也會在附近找安全的住宿。
abroad
出國
What everyday task might feel difficult during your first week abroad?
Buying groceries abroad could be difficult if I could not read the labels. I would bring a short list with translated names.
剛出國時，看不懂標籤可能連買菜都不容易。我會帶一張寫好翻譯的簡單清單。
culture
文化
How would you learn about a local culture without making assumptions?
I would ask respectful questions about local culture and listen carefully. One person's experience would not tell me everything about a whole country.
我會尊重地請教當地文化，也仔細聽。不能只靠一個人的經驗，就推論整個國家。
custom
習俗
How would you handle a local custom you did not understand?
I would ask someone to explain the custom before joining in. Understanding its meaning would help me avoid accidental disrespect.
參與之前，我會先請人解釋這個習俗。了解它的意義，比較不會無意間失禮。
language
語言
How would you communicate when you do not share a language with someone?
Without a shared language, I would use simple gestures and written place names. I would check that we understood each other before moving on.
語言不通時，我會用簡單手勢和寫好的地名溝通。確認彼此理解後，再進行下一步。
guide
導遊
When would hiring a local guide be worth the cost?
A local guide would be useful at a complicated historical site. Stories and context could help me understand more than the signs alone.
逛歷史背景複雜的景點時，請導遊很值得。他補充的故事，能讓我比只看告示了解更多。
explore
探索
How would you explore an unfamiliar city during a free afternoon?
I would explore one walkable neighbourhood rather than rush across the city. A market and a small park would be good starting points.
我會選一個適合步行的街區慢慢探索，不急著跑遍整座城。市場和小公園就是不錯的起點。
